The structure of Zn4Ag8As4 (reduced formula ZnAg2As) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows all three elements in tetrahedral coordination: Ag centers have four geometric neighbors (two As, two Zn), while As and Zn centers each have four Ag neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.6245 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between Ag tetrahedra and between As and Zn tetrahedra, with edge-sharing observed between Ag tetrahedra.
